listing.name: Unoffical Captions Log Printer V1.0
listing.summary: hello everyone! have you ever written 300+ logs with the 'captions logs' mod, and just wanted to read them in the order you made them? or simply wanted to store them in a text file? now you can! this mod will write the contents of all your captions logs to the starsector.log, on game load and save.

description:
hello everyone! have you ever written 300+ logs with the 'captions logs' mod, and just wanted to read them in the order you made them? or simply wanted to store them in a text file?
now you can! this mod will write the contents of all your captions logs to the starsector.log, on game load and save.
works in the last version of starsector as well, just change its version in the mod_info
download: https://github.com/Alaricdragon/UnofficalCaptionsLogPrinter/archive/refs/heads/master.zip

FAQ
Q: what?
A: look, I wasted 9 hours of my life getting screenshots of my captions logs and then organizing them. never again. is that enough for you?

Q: I don't like finding the logs in the starsector.log, cant you print them to there own text file
A: no. starsector wont let me 😦

Q: who is even asking the questions here?
A: no one. I just wanted to complain.
